rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep and write a unanimous, administrable opinion cabining “any person adversely affected” to parties whose legal rights/duties are directly altered by the FDA order, preventing venue manipulation. Separate concurrences are most likely from Gorsuch/Alito/Thomas/Barrett to emphasize, respectively, anti-forum-shopping/Article II enforcement-discretion concerns and the O’Bannon-style line between direct legal effects and downstream economic ripple effects.
